units.source_text: 开始焚香，举行了向自法师献上谢恩香的嗣法香仪式。

en.t: Incense began to be burned, and the ceremony of offering the succession incense in gratitude to Master Ji was performed.

units.source_text: 昔日禅宗不拘惯例，非常重视个人省悟的源流，

en.t: In earlier times, Zen Buddhism was not bound by convention and placed great importance on the lineage of each person's own awakening,

units.source_text: 在这样的时代，与其说是师父决定弟子，毋宁说是弟子选择师父。

en.t: and in such an age, it was less the master who chose the disciple than the disciple who chose the master.

units.source_text: 弟子不仅接受最初投业的师父，

en.t: The disciple did not merely accept the master under whom he had first entered training,

units.source_text: 还接受各方师父的证明悟道的熟达程度，

en.t: but also accepted the degree of maturity in enlightenment attested by masters from various places,

units.source_text: 并且必须在献嗣法香时解释佛法的妙语里公开自己心目中拟承继其法的师父的名字。

en.t: and when offering the succession incense, he had to make public, in the subtle words with which he expounded the Buddha Dharma, the name of the master whose teaching he intended to inherit.
